FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: Won't self-massage stretch my skin even more?
FAQ.a1: This is the most common concern, but the opposite is true. My techniques target muscles and fascia (the internal structure of the face), not surface skin stretching. As a certified cosmetologist, I'll teach you how to fix tissues and work at depth. This restores the skin's natural support, so it actually tightens and firms up.
FAQ.q2: Do I really only need my own hands? No tools required?
FAQ.a2: Exactly. Your hands are the most perfect and sensitive instrument. In the course, I'll teach you how to properly use your palms, knuckles, and fingers to achieve sculptural and lifting effects. No expensive devices or gua-sha stones needed — your "beauty studio" is always with you.
FAQ.q3: How soon will I see the first results?
FAQ.a3: You'll notice reduced morning puffiness and healthier skin tone right after the first session. With regular practice (just 15 minutes), after 7 days you'll feel muscle tension release, and after 21 days you'll notice firmer contours and smoother fine lines. Results are cumulative — the longer you practice, the better your face looks.
FAQ.q4: Is the course suitable for sensitive skin or after procedures?
FAQ.a4: Yes. Thanks to my personal experience with cancer treatment, I place absolute emphasis on safety and gentleness. The Well-age method is designed to respect skin health. If you've had Botox or fillers, I recommend starting the massage after absorption (usually 2-4 weeks) to prolong their effect and support tissue regeneration.
FAQ.q5: Is the course suitable for complete beginners?
FAQ.a5: Yes, the course is built "from zero." I explain everything step by step — from how to properly wash your hands to deep massage techniques. No prior experience or cosmetology knowledge is needed. I'm your guide and I'll lead your hands the entire time.
FAQ.q6: How will I receive the course and how long will I have access?
FAQ.a6: Immediately after payment confirmation, you'll receive login credentials to the member area via email. You have lifetime access. You can return to it in a year, two years, or whenever your skin needs extra care. Videos can be watched online on computer, tablet, or phone.
FAQ.a7: If you encounter technical issues accessing the course or didn't receive your credentials after payment, don't hesitate to contact me. I'm here for you. Write me on WhatsApp: +420 608 236 696
